Our Gold bot is an AI-powered automated trading system that trades the gold market for you through your MT5 account. We connect the software to your MT5 credentials, and it opens and closes trades automatically when market conditions are suitable. 

How you get started
You use an MT5 broker account (we typically work with brokers like Vantage and PU Prime). 
Minimum to start is generally $500. 
Once you provide your MT5 credentials, it usually takes 24–48 hours to connect and start trading. 
You can also test it first on a demo MT5 account for 10 days. 

Costs / profit share
There’s no upfront cost; we work on a profit-sharing model.
At month-end, profits are split 65/35: you keep 65% and we take 35%. 

Returns and risk
Returns vary by market conditions; historically they’ve ranged around 10%–30% per month, and for gold specifically we target roughly 8%–30% on average. Returns are not guaranteed. 
Risk is managed by automatically adjusting lot size and trade volume based on your account size (built-in risk management). 

Control of funds
You keep full ownership and control of the account and can withdraw anytime; we can trade on MT5 but can’t deposit/withdraw or move your funds. 

Do you want to run it on a demo first, or are you looking to start live with around $500+?
